scientific_integrity: An explicit all-depth proof is supplied. Finite checker outputs corroborate without certifying the infinite theorem; priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only distinct factors of lengths \(3^k\) for integers \(k\ge1\) in the binary Cantor fixed point; no claims for occurrence-weighted frequencies or general lengths. Priority risk: the complete 2016 publisher text was inaccessible; published indexed sections and the related 2017 open text were inspected.
title: Exact Abelian multiplicities and a dense atomic limit for Cantor factors
